evidence_slice: Great Yarmouth Borough Council's Employment Land Needs Review, November 2024, identifies GN5 Beacon Business Park Extension as a 20.12 hectare employment site that benefits from Enterprise Zone status and remains completely undeveloped at present. The adopted Local Plan Part 2 Policy GN5 allocates the site for office, research and development, light industrial, and storage and distribution uses, particularly those supporting the offshore energy industry.
